title: Etale morphisms restrict to compatible open subschemes
statement: Let $p:U\to V$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A\subseteq U$ and $B\subseteq V$ be open subschemes with $p(A)\subseteq B$. Then the induced restriction $p|_A:A\to B$ is etale. No quasi-compactness, separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.
